review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: Track the set of possible robot positions as a bitset. Each command shifts movable positions and retains those whose destination is a wall; perimeter walls prevent row wrap. Coalescing positions is exact because future transitions are deterministic. Return first prefix whose possibility set is exactly exit, allowing earlier visits/leavings and initial single-cell0.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
